Hi Jordan / Laura —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about AcmePayments' roadmap for integrating LLM features into your payments product. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs from our call:
- Sensitive PII/transactional data flowing through inference (must remain in-customer network)
- Strict data residency and audit requirements for Q4 pilot -> production
- Target latency under 150ms p95, bursty workloads around month-end

Why Redwood Private (VPC) looks like the fit:
- Private control plane + VPC peering keeps data in your network
- KMS integrations for customer-managed keys and audit logs for compliance
- Configurable dedicated GPU capacity to meet p95 latency SLOs

Attachments I’ve included: redwood-vpc-playbook.pdf (architecture patterns & deployment checklist) and redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 evidence summary). I’ll also prepare a dedicated-pricing-quote.xlsx for your procurement team.

Proposed next steps:
1) I can schedule a 60m architecture session with our Solutions Engineer (Jonas) to validate network & topology options — available next Tue/Wed afternoon PT.
2) I’ll share a dedicated pricing quote for a pilot (3 months) and an estimated ramp to production.
3) Please share any procurement/legal contacts and preferred security questionnaire format.

If Q4 is still your target, getting the architecture session scheduled this month will keep us on track. 

Happy to adjust — what time works for you for the architecture call?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
